name: idea-realization
description: Take an idea from capture through triage, partition, planning, phases and backlog to governed documents, in any git repository.

ideas_path.title: Idea log
ideas_path.description: Append-only idea event log, relative to the repository root.

ideas_view_path.title: Rendered idea view
ideas_view_path.description: Generated Markdown view of the idea log, relative to the repository root.

priority_path.title: Idea priority queue
priority_path.description: Hand-ordered list of idea ids that jump the queue, relative to the repository root.

backlog_path.title: Backlog
backlog_path.description: Phase catalog, relative to the repository root.

docs_root.title: Document root
docs_root.description: Directory holding governed documents, the code register and the systems registry, relative to the repository root.

integration_branch.title: Integration branch
integration_branch.description: Branch that finished work merges into. Leave empty to use the project's control.integration_branch, or main when none is set.

worktree_dir.title: Worktree directory
worktree_dir.description: Directory that holds one worktree per session. It must resolve outside the repository; a relative value is taken from the primary checkout, so the default names a sibling directory. <repository> is replaced by the repository directory's name.

triage_search.title: Triage search list
triage_search.description: Directories and files the triage agent searches for related material, relative to the repository root.

exempt_files.title: Exempt files
exempt_files.description: Markdown files under the document root that carry no front matter, relative to the repository root.

staging_dir.title: Staging directory
staging_dir.description: Gitignored directory for partition drafts and corpora, relative to the repository root.

partitions_dir.title: Partitions directory
partitions_dir.description: Directory the accepted idea partitions are copied into, relative to the repository root.

brain_root.title: Brain
brain_root.description: The team's shared memory: decisions, research, concepts, entities and learnings as markdown entries, relative to the repository root.

product_root.title: Product checkout
product_root.description: This machine's checkout of the product repository the control repository drives. It must resolve outside this repository; leave it empty when no product repository is used. Never tracked, because it differs per machine.

product_worktree_dir.title: Product worktree directory
product_worktree_dir.description: Directory that holds one product worktree per session. A relative value is taken from the product checkout, so the default names a directory beside it; it must resolve outside both checkouts. <product> is replaced by the product checkout's directory name.

aws_read_profile.title: AWS read profile
aws_read_profile.description: The named AWS CLI profile for the sandbox's read-only role, used by the read-only cloud agents on this machine; never the default profile. The agents refuse to run while it is empty.

aws_deploy_profile.title: AWS deploy profile
aws_deploy_profile.description: The named AWS CLI profile for the sandbox's deploy role, whose only IAM rights cover /app/ roles that carry the permission boundary and which has no Organizations or billing rights; used only by the deploying agent. Never the default profile. The deploying agent refuses to run while it is empty.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: The AWS region the cloud agents use on this machine. The agents refuse to run while it is empty.

handle.title: Developer handle
handle.description: The developer handle this machine asserts. It is refused unless git config user.email belongs to that developer in systems.yaml; leave it empty to take the handle from the git email alone.

dev_port_range.title: Developer server ports
dev_port_range.description: The local ports a development server on this machine may use, as <first>-<last>, so two developers' servers on a shared host do not collide. Empty means no range is set.

control_remote.title: Control repository URL
control_remote.description: Git URL of the control repository. check.py and doctor.py report a control checkout whose origin differs; while it is empty the comparison is skipped. Set it in local.yaml when the URL must not be tracked; project.yaml control.remote is read below the plugin option.

control_github.title: Control repository on GitHub
control_github.description: The control repository on GitHub, as <org>/<repo>, for gh commands. Set it in local.yaml when it must not be tracked; project.yaml control.github is read below the plugin option.

product_remote.title: Product repository URL
product_remote.description: Git URL of the product repository. product.py verify refuses a product checkout whose origin differs, and refuses while it is empty. Set it in local.yaml when the URL must not be tracked; product.yaml remote is read below the plugin option.

product_github.title: Product repository on GitHub
product_github.description: The product repository on GitHub, as <org>/<repo>, for gh commands. Set it in local.yaml when it must not be tracked; product.yaml github is read below the plugin option.
